_comment: Release automation config. minimumSupportedVersionCode: if omitted or 0, defaults to the new versionCode (fully mandatory). Set it LOWER than the new versionCode to allow older versions to keep working. releaseNotes: bullets shown on the update screen. You only edit THIS file and the versionCode/versionName in app/build.gradle.kts — the workflow generates version.json and the GitHub Release automatically.
releaseNotes: NEW: Formula is now a repeating per-clip motion pattern (clip 1 → motion 1, clip 2 → motion 2, then repeats)
24 motion presets, 20 formula patterns, 20 transitions, 23 effects — every card has a live preview
Safe-scale rendering: no more black/empty edges during pan, slide or zoom
Bottom-sheet tool panels — the preview no longer shrinks; swipe to close
Unlimited custom formulas with add / reorder / delete steps
More reliable export timing, validation, play and share
